title: Tumble Forth – From Assembly to OS with a C Compiler
summary: A series of educational articles by Virgil Dupras, author of Collapse OS and Dusk OS, aimed at guiding programmers with limited low-level experience through the process of building an operating system from scratch. The series starts with bare-metal programming on the PC platform, progresses through creating a Forth system, and culminates in developing a partial C compiler within Dusk OS.
key_points: Targeted at programmers familiar with high-level development but new to low-level programming.
Step-by-step guide to building a Forth system from scratch on bare metal.
Transition to Dusk OS and development of a partial C compiler.
Focuses on broadening perspectives on computing fundamentals and reducing modern software complexity.
Structured as a series of articles with clear objectives and story arcs.
Encourages reader engagement and feedback for clarification.
